company.name: Checkout.com
company.shortDescription: Checkout.com is a global provider of payment solutions that help businesses and communities thrive in the digital economy.
company.description: Checkout.com provides the fastest, most reliable payments in more than 150 currencies, with in-country acquiring, world-class fraud filters and reporting through one API. Checkout.com can accept all major international credit and debit cards and popular alternative and local payment methods. The company launched in 2012 and now has a team of more than 1700 people across 19 offices worldwide, offering local expertise where it’s needed.

aiResearchSummary.text: Checkout.com is researching an account linking system that uses a server and user device to extract and analyze a shopper’s purchase history to verify item purchases. The account linking system description shows work on secure data retrieval, linking user accounts across services, and automated verification workflows. Overall, they are developing purchase verification, secure account linkage, and transaction data processing capabilities.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,000,000,000 to $40,000,000,000, a 20x increase.

caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
